originalTitle: Body of missing runner found in South Africa
title: Staying Safe: A Story from South Africa
content:
Hello, Super Kids of Africa!

Hi everyone! It's your friendly news reporter, Kiki, here. I have a story for you today from a very special country in Africa called South Africa. Sometimes, news can be a little bit sad, but it's important to learn from everything that happens. We will talk about how we can all stay safe and help each other.

About Elizabeth and Her Love for Running

Our story is about a kind lady named Elizabeth Moselakgomo. Elizabeth loved to run. Running is when you use your legs to go very fast! It makes your body feel strong and happy. Elizabeth was a runner, and she loved to keep fit and active. She liked being out and about, moving her body. Did you know? Running is a super way to keep your heart healthy! It makes your blood pump and gives you lots of energy to play all day!

When Someone Goes Missing

One day, Elizabeth went missing. When someone goes missing, it means they are not where they should be. Their family and friends cannot find them. This makes everyone feel very worried and sad. When Elizabeth went missing, many, many people started to look for her. They wanted to help find her and bring her home.

Everyone Helped to Look!

Because so many people were worried about Elizabeth, a big search started. It was called a 'nationwide appeal.' Imagine if all the grown-ups in your town, and even in other towns, started looking for someone! That's how big it was. People shared pictures of Elizabeth everywhere. They asked everyone, 'Have you seen Elizabeth? Can you help us find her?' It showed how much people care for each other in South Africa. Did you know? When many people work together, it's called teamwork! Teamwork helps us do amazing things, like finding someone or building a tall sandcastle!

Sad News and What We Feel

Sadly, after some time, Elizabeth was found. It was very, very sad news. She was not alive anymore. This made many people feel very, very sad. It's okay to feel sad when bad things happen. It's okay to talk about your feelings with a grown-up you trust. Sometimes, news can make our hearts feel a bit heavy. When Elizabeth was found, the police also found four other ladies who had been missing. They were found in the same area. This news made people even more worried and sad. But it also made the police work extra hard to understand what happened.

Being Safe When You Play or Go Out

This sad story reminds us all about how important it is to stay safe every day. When you go outside to play, or walk to a friend's house, always remember some very important rules. These rules help keep you safe, just like seatbelts keep you safe in a car! Rule number one: Always, always tell a grown-up where you are going. This could be your mom, your dad, your grandma, your uncle, or your teacher. They need to know where you are at all times. This is super important! Rule number two: Try to go with a friend or a grown-up. It's always safer to be with someone you know and trust. Don't go to places all by yourself, especially not to quiet or hidden places. Playing with friends is more fun anyway! Rule number three: If you ever feel scared, or if someone you don't know talks to you in a way that makes you feel worried, what should you do? You should run away to a safe place! Run to a grown-up you trust, like a shopkeeper or a security guard. And shout as loud as you can! 'Help me!' or 'No!' Did you know? Talking to a grown-up you trust is a superpower! They can help you with anything, big or small, that makes you feel worried.

Our Community Stays Strong

The police are like real-life superheroes. They wear uniforms, and their job is to keep everyone safe. When sad things happen, like what happened to Elizabeth and the other ladies, the police work very hard. They try to find out exactly what happened and make sure bad things don't happen again. They are working very hard right now in South Africa to understand everything and to keep people safe. In Africa, we are very good at helping each other. We are like a big, big family. When someone is sad, we give them a hug. When someone needs help, we offer our hand. This is called community spirit. Even though this news is sad, it shows how much people care. It shows that we will always look out for each other.

Let's Be Kind and Safe

So, my wonderful kids, let's remember this story to help us be safe. Always tell a grown-up where you are going. Always try to be with a friend or grown-up. And if you ever feel worried, run and tell a trusted adult! We must also remember to be kind to each other every day. Let's keep our communities strong and safe. Be kind, be brave, and always be safe!
summary: Elizabeth Moselakgomo, a lady who loved to run in South Africa, went missing, and sadly, she was later found, which made many people very sad; this story reminds us all to always stay safe by telling a grown-up where we are going and staying with friends.
whyMatters: This story is important because it teaches us about being safe when we go outside, always telling a grown-up where we are, and staying with friends, so we can play happily and our families know we are okay.

originalTitle: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
title: Africa's Wild Dogs Go on a Super Long Adventure!
content:
Hello from Africa!

Hello everyone! I'm your friendly news reporter right here in beautiful Africa. Today, I have a super exciting story to share with you. It's about some very special animals and their amazing journey. Get ready to learn about bravery and hope! Our story takes us to a country in Africa called Zambia. Zambia is a wonderful place with lots of open spaces for animals to live. It has big rivers, green forests, and sunny plains.

Meet Our Amazing Wild Dogs!

Have you ever heard of a wild dog? They are also called 'painted wolves' because their fur looks like it's been painted with different colours – brown, black, white, and yellow. Every wild dog has a unique coat, just like our fingerprints are unique! Wild dogs are very special animals. They have big, round ears that help them hear everything around them. They are super-fast runners and love to play with their families. Did you know? Wild dogs are very social animals. This means they love to live and hunt together in big families called 'packs'. They look after each other, especially the little puppies.

The Super-Duper Long Trip

Guess what? Three brave wild dog brothers went on an incredible adventure! They travelled an unbelievably long way across Zambia. How far, you ask? They travelled about 2,500 miles! Can you imagine 2,500 miles? That's like driving across a whole country, then turning around and doing it again, and again, many times! It's an adventure that would take a car many, many days to finish. These three brothers walked all that way, day after day, week after week. They were looking for something very important. What could it be?

Why Did They Travel So Far?

The three wild dog brothers were on a quest! They were searching for new friends, new families. They wanted to find a special female wild dog to start their very own families with. When animals look for a special friend to have babies with, we call it looking for a 'mate'. It's very important for animals to find mates so they can have more puppies and keep their species strong. Finding new families helps the wild dogs stay healthy. It also helps make sure there are enough wild dogs for the future. They wanted to find a new home where they could build their own pack. Did you know? Wild dogs are an 'endangered' species. This means there are not many of them left in the world. So, every new puppy is very important!

How Do We Know Their Secret?

How do we know these wild dogs went on such a long journey? Did they send us a postcard? No! Scientists helped us. Scientists put special collars on some wild dogs. These collars are like little smartwatches for animals. They don't hurt the dogs at all. The collars tell the scientists where the dogs go every single day. They send a signal, like a little message, to the scientists. This is how we know exactly how far these three brothers travelled. It's like they had their own special GPS, telling their whole story! It helped us understand their brave mission and see how amazing they truly are.

Brave Travellers Face Challenges

Imagine walking 2,500 miles! What kinds of things do you think these wild dogs saw? They probably saw many different places. They had to cross big rivers and climb over hills. They had to find food every day and find safe places to sleep at night. They had to be very careful of other animals, too. Sometimes, animals face dangers from people building more farms and towns. This means less space for wild animals to live freely. But these brothers were smart and found their way around. Their journey shows us how tough and clever wild dogs are. They faced many challenges but kept going to reach their goal.

Why This Big Trip Gives Us Hope

This amazing journey by the three wild dog brothers is super important news! It gives everyone hope. Why? Because sometimes, it's hard for wild animals to find safe places to live. People are building more homes and farms, which means less wild space for animals. But these wild dogs showed us that animals are strong. They can travel far to find new homes and new families. They are clever and can adapt to changes in their world. This trip tells us that even when things are tough, wildlife can still find ways to survive and thrive. It means there's a chance for more wild dog puppies in the future!

Protecting Our Painted Friends

This story reminds us how important it is to protect our wild animals and their homes. We need to make sure they have enough space to live and roam freely. Every animal, big or small, plays an important part in our world. Wild dogs help keep their environment healthy. By protecting them, we help keep our whole planet healthy. What can you do? You can tell your friends and family about the amazing painted wolves! You can learn more about animals and how we can help them. Every little bit helps our animal friends in Africa and all over the world. Thank you for listening to this wonderful story!
summary: Three brave wild dog brothers journeyed an incredible 2,500 miles across Zambia, Africa, looking for new families, showing that animals are strong and can find ways to survive even when their world changes.
whyMatters: This amazing trip by the wild dogs shows us that animals are very strong and clever. Even when there's less space for them because people build more homes, they can still find new places and new friends to have babies, which gives us hope for their future.

originalTitle: JD Vance insists US is ‘on top of’ Houthi advance in Red Sea
title: Important Grown-Ups Are Helping Ships!
content:
Hello, my super friends! Today, we have some very important news from far, far away. It’s about big ships, a big blue sea, and some grown-ups who are working hard to keep everyone safe.

A Big Problem Far Away

Imagine a very, very busy road. But instead of cars, it’s full of giant ships! This busy road is actually a big blue part of the ocean called the Red Sea. It’s a super important path for ships carrying all sorts of cool things. Now, in a country far away, called Yemen, there’s a group of people called the Houthis. Sometimes, groups of people don’t agree, and they cause problems. The Houthis have been causing trouble on this big sea road. They have been making it hard for the big ships to pass safely. They have even shot at some ships! This is not good, because these ships carry many things that we all need and love.

Meet the Important People

Guess what? There are very important grown-ups in charge of countries. One of these grown-ups is from a big country called America. His name is Mr. JD Vance, and he is a very important helper to America’s main leader. Mr. Vance and his team have heard about the trouble in the Red Sea. They know that these ships need to be safe. And they are working super hard to make sure that happens. He said that America is 'very much on top of' the situation. What does 'on top of' mean? It means they know all about it, and they are busy finding ways to fix the problem and keep everyone safe. It’s like when your teacher knows all the answers and is helping you learn!

What is the Red Sea?

Let’s talk more about this amazing Red Sea! It’s not really red, even though it has that name. It’s a beautiful blue sea, just like other oceans. It got its name a long, long time ago, maybe from some tiny red plants that sometimes grow in it. **Did you know?** The Red Sea is one of the warmest seas in the world! It also has lots of beautiful fish and corals, like an underwater rainbow. It’s a very long and thin sea. Think of it like a shortcut! Instead of ships going all the way around a big continent, they can go through the Red Sea. This saves a lot of time and fuel.

Why are Ships Important?

Now, why do we care so much about these ships? Well, imagine all your favorite toys. Imagine the yummy food you eat every day. Imagine the clothes you wear to school. Many of these things come to us on big ships! They travel from one country to another, across big oceans and seas like the Red Sea. Without these ships, it would be very hard to get all the things we need. These ships are like giant floating trucks! Some are so big, they can carry thousands of cars, or enough food for a whole city. They need to travel safely so that everything can get to where it needs to go. **Did you know?** The biggest container ships are longer than four football fields! They can carry over 20,000 big metal boxes full of goods.

Who are the Houthis?

So, who are these Houthis who are causing trouble? They are a group of people who live in Yemen, a country near the Red Sea. They have different ideas about how things should work in their country and sometimes they fight to make their ideas happen. When they attack ships, they are trying to get attention and make their voices heard. But it makes things dangerous for everyone else who uses the sea. It’s a very grown-up problem, and it makes many people sad. But that’s why important leaders like Mr. Vance are stepping in to help make things better.

America is Helping!

Mr. Vance and the American leaders are like very strong helpers. They are sending their own ships, like big friendly guardians, to watch over the Red Sea. They want to make sure the paths are clear and safe for all the other ships. They are talking to other countries too, asking everyone to work together. Because when everyone works together, problems can be solved much faster and better. Think of it like when you and your friends work together on a big school project. It’s much easier and more fun! **Did you know?** America has one of the biggest navies in the world! A navy is like an army, but for ships and the sea, helping to protect oceans and coasts.

Working for Peace

What everyone wants is peace. Peace means everyone is safe, happy, and can go about their day without worry. When the Red Sea is safe, ships can deliver all their important goods without any fear. This helps everyone, even us! Because if ships can’t travel safely, the things we need might become harder to find, or cost more money. So, keeping the sea safe is super important for happy homes all around the world, including here in Africa. Mr. Vance and other leaders are trying to make sure the Houthis stop causing trouble. They want to find a way for everyone to live peacefully.

What Does This Mean for Us?

Even though the Red Sea is far away from us in Africa, the news is still important! Many ships travel through the Red Sea carrying things that come to our homes. So, when important grown-ups like Mr. Vance say they are working hard to keep the Red Sea safe, it’s good news for everyone. It means they are looking out for all of us, so we can keep getting our food, toys, and clothes. It reminds us that even far-away problems can affect us, and that people all over the world are trying their best to make things safe and happy for everyone. And that's a really good thing to know!
summary: An important person from America, Mr. JD Vance, says that America's leaders are working hard to keep big ships safe in a very important blue sea called the Red Sea, where a group of people called the Houthis have been causing trouble.
whyMatters: This matters because ships use the Red Sea to bring important things like food, toys, and clothes to many countries, including ours in Africa, and we want them to travel safely so we can keep getting what we need.

originalTitle: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
title: Big Countries and Super Smart Computers: Playing Fair!
content:
Jambo, my amazing friends! It's your friendly news reporter from sunny Africa, ready to share some exciting news with you! Today, we're going to talk about something super cool: smart computers! They are like super clever robots that can think and learn, and everyone wants to make the best ones!

What Are Super Smart Computers? (AI!)

Imagine you have a toy robot, but this robot isn't just any robot. This robot can learn new things all by itself! It can watch you play a game and then learn how to play it too. It can listen to your favourite song and then help you find more songs you might like. This amazing technology is called Artificial Intelligence, or AI for short. It's like giving computers a super-duper brain! These smart computers can help us do so many wonderful things, from making our games more fun to helping doctors find cures for sickness. Did you know? AI is already in many things you use every day! When you ask a grown-up's phone a question and it answers, that's AI! When you play a video game and the characters seem to learn how you play, that's AI too! These smart computers are like really clever students who never stop learning. They can look at lots and lots of information very, very quickly and then figure out patterns and make good guesses. It's truly like magic, but it's really science! They can help us solve puzzles, understand difficult patterns, and even create new stories or pictures. It's like having a super helper that can think almost like a human, but much faster and with access to so much more information. Pretty neat, right?

The Big Race for Smart Computers!

Many big countries around the world are very excited about AI. They want to make the best smart computers because these computers can help their people in so many ways. Think of it like a big, friendly race in school, where everyone wants to build the tallest tower of blocks! One big country that is very good at making smart computers is called China. It's a very, very big country far away, with lots of clever scientists and engineers. They are working really hard to make their AI super special and useful. Other countries are also working very hard. They all want their smart computers to be the most helpful and the most amazing. It's like everyone wants their team to win the best prize for being super clever! Did you know? Smart computers can help farmers figure out the best time to plant seeds, so they can grow more food for everyone! They can also help us design faster cars and even explore space! It's a really exciting time because these smart computers can help us solve big problems in the world, like climate change or making sure everyone has enough clean water. That's why so many countries want to be the best at making them. Everyone hopes that by making smarter computers, they can make life better for the people living in their country and around the world. It’s like a friendly competition to see who can come up with the most helpful inventions.

A New Idea: Should We Slow Down?

So, because China is working super fast and doing such a great job with their smart computers, some people started talking. A clever person named the CEO of a company called Anthropic had an idea. This person said, 'Maybe we should all slow down just a little bit with making our smart computers even smarter. If China goes too fast, maybe other countries won't be able to catch up!' It was like saying, 'Let's all take a breather so everyone can stay together in the race!' The idea was that if everyone took a little pause, it would give other countries a chance to make their own smart computers better too. It was like wanting everyone to have a fair chance to shine and show what they can do. Did you know? Sometimes, when we learn new things too fast, we might miss important steps. Taking a little pause can help us learn better and make sure everything is safe and sound, especially with something as powerful as AI. This idea was about making sure that the 'race' was fair for everyone. Like in a game, you don't want one player to get so far ahead that no one else has a chance to win. Everyone likes a fair game, right? They thought that a little pause would help make sure that smart computers are developed safely and that everyone has a chance to contribute to this amazing technology.

China Says: 'That's Not Fair Play!'

But then, China heard about this idea, and they didn't think it was a very kind thing to say. China said, 'Hey! We are working hard and doing our best. It's not fair to ask us to slow down just so others can catch up!' They felt like it was trying to stop them from succeeding. China said this idea was like 'malicious competition.' Imagine your friend saying, 'You're too good at drawing, please draw a little worse so I can win the art competition!' That wouldn't feel very fair, would it? China believes that everyone should be allowed to work as hard and as fast as they can to make their smart computers the best. They think that when everyone tries their best, it helps everyone in the long run. Did you know? When countries work together and share their ideas about smart computers, everyone benefits! It's like when you share your toys with a friend, and you both have more fun and learn from each other! They want to make sure that the 'race' is about friendly competition, where everyone tries their best, not about trying to stop others from doing well. They believe that a world where everyone is encouraged to be their best is a better world for everyone. Stopping someone from trying their best is not what friendly competition is about. China wants to keep inventing and improving without being told to slow down, just like any child wants to show how well they can do in school.

Why Is This Important For Us?

You might be thinking, 'Why do I need to know about big countries and smart computers?' Well, my friends, because these smart computers can help us all! They can help make our schools better, help doctors keep us healthy, and even help us learn more about our amazing planet. If countries work together and play fair, then everyone around the world, even us here in Africa, can benefit from these amazing inventions! Imagine smart computers helping to clean up our environment or making sure every child has a great teacher. These are the kinds of wonderful things AI can do when people share and work together. Did you know? Learning about new things like AI helps you understand the world better and can even inspire you to become a super scientist or inventor one day! So, when countries talk about smart computers, it's not just about who is first. It's about how we can all work together to make the world a better, smarter, and kinder place for everyone. Let's hope all the countries remember to play fair and share their amazing ideas!
summary: Big countries are racing to make super smart computers (AI), and while one company suggested China slow down so others could catch up, China said that wasn't fair play.
whyMatters: This matters because smart computers can help us all make the world a better place, and it's important for countries to work together and play fair so everyone can benefit from these amazing inventions.

originalTitle: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
title: A Train Story from Far Away!
content:
Hello, Super Reporters!

Good day, my amazing young friends across Africa! I'm your kid-friendly news reporter, here to share a story from a place far, far away. It’s a story about a train, a special visitor, and a little bit of a puzzle. We always learn new things together, and today is no special day to learn. So, let’s go!

A Special Visitor!

Imagine a very important friend coming to visit your town. Everyone would be excited, right? Well, a very special friend named Mr. Boris Johnson, who used to be the leader of a country called the United Kingdom (we can call it the UK), made a special trip. He wasn't alone! He came with other important friends from countries nearby in Europe. They are all like big brothers and sisters to their countries. Did you know? Leaders like Mr. Johnson visit other countries to talk about important things, like how to be good friends and help each other. It’s like when you visit a friend’s house to play and talk about your toys!

Where Did They Go?

These important visitors, Mr. Johnson and his friends, went to a country called Ukraine. It’s a beautiful country with lots of fields of yellow sunflowers. They visited a train station there. A train station is like a big bus stop for trains, where people get on and off, and where trains start and stop their journeys. They had important meetings and probably talked about how to help Ukraine. After their visit, they got ready to leave. They waved goodbye, feeling happy about their visit and the good talks they had.

Leaving the Station!

Mr. Johnson and the other important visitors had finished their special visit to Ukraine. They were all safe and sound, and they left the train station. They were going back home, probably thinking about all the things they learned and talked about. It was a normal goodbye, just like when you leave school after a fun day of learning and playing.

What Happened to a Train?

Now, here’s the puzzle part. Shortly after Mr. Johnson and his friends left the station, something happened to a train. Not a train with people inside, thankfully! It was a special kind of train part, called a 'locomotive'. A locomotive is like the engine of a train; it’s the powerful part that pulls all the other wagons. This locomotive was just sitting there, waiting on the tracks. It was what we call 'stationary', which means it wasn't moving at all. Did you know? Trains are super important! They carry people to different places, and they also carry lots of goods, like food, clothes, and toys, from one town to another. They travel on special roads made of metal, called tracks.

The Train Was Hurt

Sadly, this stationary locomotive was hurt. It was hit by something, and it got damaged. Luckily, because it was just sitting there and no one was on it, no people got hurt. That's the most important thing! But it made a loud noise, and it caused a problem. This happened near a place called the 'Polish border'. A border is like an imaginary line on a map that tells you where one country ends and another country begins. So, this train was near the edge of Ukraine, close to another friendly country called Poland. Did you know? Some borders have fences or rivers, but many are just lines that we draw on maps. When you travel from one country to another, you cross a border!

Why Did This Happen?

This is the biggest puzzle. The news said that a country called Russia did this. But Mr. Johnson, the special visitor, said he didn’t understand why. He used a big word, 'warped logic,' which just means he couldn’t understand the reason behind it. It didn't make sense to him, or to many grown-ups. Sometimes, countries have big disagreements, like when friends have a big argument. And sometimes, sad things happen because of these disagreements. Everyone, including Mr. Johnson, is trying to understand why someone would hurt a train that was just sitting there. Did you know? Grown-ups work very hard to try and fix disagreements between countries. They want everyone to be friends and live in peace, just like we do in our classrooms and communities.

Why Peace is Important

When we hear stories like this from far away, it reminds us how important peace is. Peace means being friends, helping each other, and not having big arguments that hurt anyone or anything. In Africa, we know a lot about friendship and helping each other, right? We want to see peace all over the world, even in faraway places like Ukraine. This train story is a little bit sad because something was damaged. But it’s also a story that reminds us to be kind, to look out for each other, and to always hope for a world where trains can travel safely, and all people can live in friendship.

Sending Good Thoughts!

So, my young friends, that’s our news story for today. It’s a reminder that even when confusing things happen, we can always wish for goodness and peace. Let’s send our good thoughts to everyone in Ukraine and hope that everything gets better soon. We believe in friendship and a peaceful world for all. See you next time for more news from Africa and beyond!
summary: After important visitors, including former UK leader Boris Johnson, left a train station in Ukraine, a stationary train engine was sadly damaged by Russia, leaving many grown-ups puzzled as to why it happened.
whyMatters: This story matters because it shows that even far away, things can happen that are confusing and not kind, and it reminds us all, no matter where we live, why it's super important for countries to be friends and live in peace.

originalTitle: Left in the dark - will fans ever get to hear live VAR audio?
title: Hear Me! The Secret Sounds of Football!
content:
Hello, fantastic football fans! It's me, your friendly African news reporter, ready to share some super exciting news about our favourite game! Here in Africa, we absolutely LOVE football, don't we? Kicking the ball, cheering for goals, and watching our heroes play is just the best! Today, we're talking about something super important that helps the game stay fair. It's called VAR! But there's a little secret about VAR that many people wish wasn't a secret. We can't hear the special talks that the referees have! Let's find out more!

What is VAR? A Super Helper for Football!

Imagine you are playing football with your friends. Sometimes, it's hard to see everything that happens at once, right? Maybe the ball went out, or someone scored a goal but maybe they pushed first. It can be tricky! Well, in big football games, there's a special helper called VAR. VAR stands for **Video Assistant Referee**. Wow, that's a big name! But what it means is that there are other referees sitting in a special room. They watch the game on many, many TVs, with lots of different camera angles. They are like super detectives! These VAR helpers are there to make sure the main referee on the field gets the really big decisions right. Things like: Was that a goal? Was that a penalty kick? Did someone get a red card by mistake? They whisper to the main referee through a special earpiece. Did you know? VAR helps make sure the game is super fair for everyone! It's like having extra eyes to catch everything.

Super Secret Sounds: What We Can't Hear

Now, here's the mystery! When the VAR helpers talk to the main referee, they use special radios. They chat about what they see on their screens. They might say, "Hey, did you see that player touch the ball with their hand?" or "Let's check if that goal was offside!" This talking is called **audio**, which just means sound! But guess what? We, the fans watching at home or in the stadium, cannot hear this secret chat! It's like they're having a very important, secret conversation, and we're not invited to listen in. We can see the referee putting their hand to their ear, but we can't hear a peep! Did you know? We can hear the commentator's voices, and the crowd cheering, but not the referees' special talks. It's like listening to only half a phone call!

Why Do We Want to Listen?

Good question! Why would kids like you, or even grown-ups, want to hear the referees' secret talks? Well, because it would be so much fun and help us understand! Imagine you are watching a really exciting match. Suddenly, the referee stops the game and goes to look at a TV screen on the side of the field. This means they are checking something with VAR. Everyone gets super curious! What are they looking at? What are they saying to the VAR team? If we could hear them, we would know exactly why they are checking something. It would be like being a detective right there with them! We would understand why they make their big decisions. It would make the game even more thrilling because we'd be part of the whole process. We would learn more about the rules of football too! Did you know? Knowing why something happens makes it much easier to understand and remember! It's like knowing why your teacher gives you homework – it helps you learn!

Nearly 10 Years Old!

Can you believe it? VAR has been helping out in football for almost 10 years! That's a long, long time. It's almost as old as some of your older brothers or sisters! And even after all these years, we still don't get to hear what the referees are saying during those important VAR checks.
